answer.explanation: The live configuration of the Thumbnailer was modified at 00:21:37Z, just before the window. Its OUTPUT_BUCKET is now 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca', while the IaC template sets OUTPUT_BUCKET to the OutputBucket resource (lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi, the same bucket used by the other functions). Within the window, the Thumbnailer logs repeated 'NoSuchBucket' errors on PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET, confirming the misconfiguration. The IAM role permissions are consistent with the IaC and the error is a bucket-not-found, not an AccessDenied, so this is not an IAM issue. The template itself is unchanged from intent, so the drift is in the live configuration.
